The '''Presteen system''' was located in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was connected to the [[Caltinia system/Legends|Caltinia]] and [[Veron system/Legends|Veron systems]] by the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Presteen]], which was ruled by the lesser [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] of [[House Araba]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The part of ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'' mentioning Presteen describes the state of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] approximately three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sula (queen)|Sula]] of Presteen traveled to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a floating [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of the<ref name="RE">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> Mid Rim<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Presteen [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]], which placed the system in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
